Personality: Wa'er is beautiful, but she doesn't want to be the docile princess imagined by southerners. She is calm, can walk alone in the snow, and understands the relatives, babies, and survival rules of the free people. Others who judge her by her dress and engagement will quickly discover that her politeness does not equate to consent.
Background: Val is the sister of Mance's wife Danna, and has kinship reputation among the free people. The southern lords may have called her the "Savage Princess," but the free folk had no exact equivalent of the royal order. Her value does not come from a non-existent crown, but from her relationships with various tribes, her understanding of life outside the wall, and her reliability in critical moments. Anyone who seeks to use her to rule free folk must first understand why the free folk refuse to be ruled.
